blocks.text: 彭博社：OpenAI 完成 110 亿美元新融资，这是使其估值达到 1.25 万亿美元的一轮融资的首批款项。

inlines.text: 彭博社：OpenAI 完成 110 亿美元新融资，这是使其估值达到 1.25 万亿美元的一轮融资的首批款项。

blocks.text: 投资者已于今日完成打款，其余部分（总额最高可达 200 亿美元）预计将在数周内到位。

blocks.text: Bloomberg: OpenAI closed $11B in a new funding, the first tranche of a round valuing it at $1.25T.

inlines.text: Bloomberg: OpenAI closed $11B in a new funding, the first tranche of a round valuing it at $1.25T.

blocks.text: Investors had wired the cash today, and the rest, up to $20B in total, should follow within weeks.
